name: Cracked Wall Paint
author: Dimitrios Savva
processing: 16-bit scan displacement, rescaled and sharpened by subtracting a wrapped 24 px blur. Neutral relief centered at 128 with gain 4.5. Preserves the original repeating tile. Lossless grayscale WebP.

name: Peeling Painted Wood
author: Dimitrios Savva (photography), Rob Tuytel (processing)
processing: Scan paint mask softened with a wrapped 0.9 px blur, combined with fine displacement after subtracting a wrapped 10 px blur. Neutral relief centered at 128. Preserves the original repeating tile. Lossless grayscale WebP.
